subject.title: fix(gateway): skip secrets.resolve when target SecretRefs use exec providers

question: Should command-secret resolution skip the gateway RPC for active exec-backed target SecretRefs and resolve them locally when local exec is allowed?
rationale: The patch is a narrow fix for the reported log-flood bug, but it changes when configured exec secret providers run locally instead of attempting gateway snapshot resolution first.

options.title: Accept the guarded local skip
options.body: Land the PR after a base refresh, keeping the active-target, inactive-target, and no-local-exec safeguards as the intended command-secret behavior.

options.title: Keep gateway-first semantics
options.body: Reject or close this PR and tolerate the current expected UNAVAILABLE noise until a gateway-owned resolver contract is designed.

options.title: Require a runtime-side redesign
options.body: Supersede this PR with a broader gateway/runtime-command-secret change if maintainers want partial snapshot success instead of CLI preflight skipping.

recommendation.title: Accept the guarded local skip
recommendation.body: Land the PR after a base refresh, keeping the active-target, inactive-target, and no-local-exec safeguards as the intended command-secret behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has recent history on the command-secret/gateway secrets path and is the current assignee for the PR.
